assets.name: hero
assets.prompt:
Create the main rSEARCH GitHub README hero by deriving a new explanatory marketing graphic from the supplied style reference. Input image 1 is only the art-direction reference: preserve the warm off-white background, matte layered white document cards, graphite type, teal connectors and tiny amber uncertainty accents. Replace the specific option-selection story with the research workflow.
Asset type: polished SaaS editorial marketing illustration, no photography or people. Wide 16:9 landscape.
Layout: left 36% contains clean large brand typography; right 60% contains a simple three-stage illustrated flow. At the left, exact large text "rSEARCH" and below it on two lines exact text "Research you" and "can inspect." A small supporting line below reads exactly "Codex or Claude."
On the right, one concise question card with an illustrated question mark feeds into a central research dossier with TWO provider-choice tabs labeled exactly "Codex" and "Claude". These are alternative provider choices, not two workers necessarily running together. Thin teal connections lead to a larger final evidence dossier with source-linked rows and one small amber unanswered-question marker. Beneath the three illustrated clusters, large legible exact functional labels: "Question", "Research", "Evidence dossier".
Keep all typography crisp and carefully spaced, restrained clean sans-serif with dark graphite text, high legibility. Generous whitespace and coherent visual hierarchy. No performance numbers, star ratings, approval seals, truth-check stamps, robots, office scenes, faces, hands, unnecessary icons, logos for other companies, invented text or microscopic pseudo-writing. This explains inspectable research, not guaranteed truth.
assets.finalEdit: Edit this hero precisely. Change only the small supporting line below the main headline on the left. Replace that entire line with exactly: "Codex or Claude." Keep the rest of the image unchanged: rSEARCH wordmark, Research you can inspect. headline, all card illustrations, provider tabs, arrows, functional labels, typography style, palette, spacing, background and 16:9 composition. The removed part of the supporting line should become clean matching off-white background. Add no other text.

assets.name: technology-selection
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: one of four coordinated explanatory marketing hero illustrations for rSEARCH operator, an evidence-backed research workflow.
Medium and art direction: a polished designed editorial graphic, a sophisticated combination of flat vector illustration and shallow sculptural 3D/paper layering. Crisp geometric silhouettes, confident graphic lines, restrained soft depth, precise arrows that explain relationships. The output should look like a high-quality SaaS product explainer campaign illustration, not a photograph of objects and not a dense technical architecture diagram.
Palette: warm off-white canvas (#F5F4EE), deep graphite (#152E36), strong teal (#007991), pale teal (#E5F2F4), with tiny amber (#D58B30) unresolved-question accents. Use consistent materials and line weights, clean matte illustrated surfaces. A single strong visual story, clear enough at thumbnail size.
Canvas and layout: wide landscape 16:9. Keep the leftmost 35% of the entire canvas completely clear warm off-white for a later marketing headline and supporting copy. All imagery and functional labels occupy the rightmost 60% of the canvas, with at least 5% padding around outer edges. Do not fill that headline space with any text, decoration, arrows, icons, shadows, grids, or gradients. Right-side composition flows clearly from inputs through an evidence relationship to an outcome. Use no more than three main visual clusters.
Text: only the short exact functional labels specified in the scene prompt, integrated under or next to the appropriate illustrated cluster, in a crisp large dark graphite sans-serif. No main headline, slogan, logo, tiny prose, pseudotext, numbers, performance claims, guarantee badges, decorative writing or invented words. Documents may show short horizontal gray blocks as abstract content.
Constraints: no people, faces, hands, desks, offices, cameras, photography, realistic computer users, lifestyle scenes, robots, holograms, glitter, stock-art decorative icons, random floating UI, gratuitous padlocks or green truth-check stamps. Illustrations must explain the actual use case and show source relationships. Teal encodes traceability and amber an unresolved question; neither promises automatic correctness.

Scene 1: Technology selection, showing the advantage of researching before choosing.
Create three clearly distinct modular technology-option tiles on the left side of the illustration area, each composed of a different clean geometric module. They feed into one central illustrated research dossier made of carefully stacked white source cards, with visible thin teal connectors from source snippets to requirement rows. On the right of the illustration area, one candidate module is framed together with a small evidence card; another stays lightly outlined and has a tiny amber open-question marker, expressing that the decision is supported but remaining uncertainty is visible. Make the evidence comparison legible, rather than implying random AI choice or automatic installation. Use exactly these three cluster labels: "Options", "Evidence", "Decision". The central evidence dossier is the hero focal point. Keep the headline space blank.
assets.alt: Choose a technology. Technology options feed an evidence comparison and an informed decision.
